notes.title: Dark Odyssey German version now available
notes.content: Dark Odyssey German version is now available. Switch the in-game language via Manage-Properties-General-Language. Please note that the English version and the German version do not share the same data. Enjoy your game!

notes.title: Upcoming Events
notes.content:
Exciting News, Dark Odyssey Adventurers! 
Gather 'round, heroes! The much-anticipated Thanksgiving event has just been unveiled on our updated event calendar! Embark on a thrilling journey filled with epic quests, bountiful rewards, and unforgettable challenges. Join us as we celebrate the spirit of gratitude and embark on a Dark Odyssey like never before!
Check out the revamped event calendar to plan your quests and mark your calendars for the Thanksgiving extravaganza! Don't miss out on the excitement – assemble your party, sharpen your blades, and dive into the mystical realms of Dark Odyssey!Adventure awaits, and glory beckons!

notes.title: Upcoming Events
notes.content:
Exciting news from the realm of Dark Odyssey! We've just unleashed a spine-tingling Halloween update that will send shivers down your spine! Embark on a thrilling adventure in our revamped in-game events, where eerie mysteries await and spooky challenges abound! Don your bravest armor, gather your most powerful spells, and join us in the heart of the Halloween festivities! Whether you're a seasoned hero or a curious newcomer, there's a place for you in this supernatural odyssey! So, grab your friends, brace yourselves, and let the Halloween gaming madness begin! See you in the haunted realms of Dark Odyssey!

notes.title: Get Ready for Some Spooky Night
notes.content:
Get ready to be spellbound because Dark Odyssey has a spooktacular Halloween update waiting just for YOU! Dive into the eerie realms of our game, now filled with haunting quests, mysterious treasures, and bone-chilling challenges that will send shivers down your spine! 
1️.New Halloween outfit
2️.New Cro-Ser boss: Albatrian
3️.New in-game events (Halloween event begins on 10/29)
4️.Optimized "Defend the village"
Join us this Halloween for an epic in-game party like never before! Gather your allies, don your most frightening costumes, and embark on a mystical journey together. Unravel the secrets of the night, confront supernatural foes, and revel in the thrill of the unknown.
Don't miss out on the creepiest adventure of the year! Log in now and let the Halloween festivities begin!
